description: Reviewed kernel ABI differences between the source stack and the official OpenWrt tree. scripts/abi_review.py stops the source composition on any difference without an entry here; see docs/kmod-compatibility.md.

reviewed.reason: Changes the exported dev_fill_forward_path() from (dev, daddr, stack) to (ctx, stack); xt_FLOWOFFLOAD in the official kmod-ipt-offload calls the 6.18 form. Series patch 0023 restores the official symbol and moves the in-tree callers to dev_fill_forward_path_ctx().
Restores the official dev_fill_forward_path() declaration and declares the additional dev_fill_forward_path_ctx() export.
Declares netif_napi_add_weight_named(_locked) only. struct napi_struct keeps the official layout; names live in a net/core table and default registration does not touch NAPI memory.
Adds the static inline nf_flow_dst_check(); no structure layout or exported interface changes.
Raises the SK_RMEM_DEFAULT default value; no structure layout or interface change.
Declares the new export br_vlan_get_offload_info_rcu(); existing interfaces are unchanged.
Appends fields to struct nf_bridge_frag_data. Only nf_conntrack_bridge (kmod-nft-bridge, in the image) reads and writes it; IPv6 passes the pointer through.

Adds NF_CT_EXT_BRXING before NF_CT_EXT_NUM. Existing IDs keep their values, modules only read ext->offset[id] as filled by the local conntrack core, and NF_CT_EXT_NUM is used only by the header and nf_conntrack_extend.c.

Replaces the exported en7523_set_uart_baud_rate() with en7523_set_divisor(). Both serve only the built-in 8250 core (CONFIG_SERIAL_8250_AIROHA=y); no official module references them. The uapi additions match the official patch.

Sound is not built in and PSTORE is: official sound kmods fail to load with unresolved symbols and official pstore kmods duplicate built-in code. airoha_eth, the NPU and MT7530 are modules instead of built in, and the default cpufreq governor is performance. None changes structures or interfaces that official feed modules use.
CONFIG_KERNEL_BUILD_DOMAIN and CONFIG_KERNEL_BUILD_USER match the official build; CONFIG_KERNEL_DEVMEM only adds the /dev/mem driver.

official_must_not_contain.reason: the official kernel now carries the dev_fill_forward_path() ctx backport; drop series patch 0023 and review 602 again
